claims: Root cause reproduced with the real actions/runner 2.338.1: an unreadable ancestor makes run.sh print 'Permission to read the directory contents is required ... each directory up the hierarchy' and exit 0.

Dockerfile: /var/lib/omega-ci and /var/lib/omega-ci/work are root:root 0755 (was 0711); a build step runs the real run.sh as the job UID/GID via setpriv in the real work root and fails on the directory error or unless it reaches 'Not configured'.

Supervisor.prepare(): work root chmod 0755 (was 0711); with a separate job identity it raises UnsafeWorkdir unless the work root and every ancestor are o+rx. Per-runner workdirs remain 0700 job-owned; hook/policy checks unchanged.

Scaler: any exit while STARTING/IDLE counts as a failed launch regardless of exit code -> backoff 15/30/60/120 s (cap 240) and circuit open after 5 (launch_circuit_open with queued + action). completed webhook naming a pool runner resets failures. Regression tests fail on base.

Agent: runner stdout+stderr relayed to the agent log (200 lines / 64 KiB per runner, per-line redaction incl. long opaque blobs, pipe always drained); on pre-job exit the newest _diag log tail (60 lines / 8 KiB, O_NOFOLLOW) is logged redacted before the workdir is deleted.

Prompt: ci_runner_scope gains Ove's 2026-10-24 rule (all CI/CD on [self-hosted, linux, x64, omega-ci], never GitHub-hosted; extend image/pool instead). OMEGA_PRIME.xml reassembled; noted in docs/ci-runners.md.

Greptile P1 (open pipes hold runner slots) fixed: runner output now uses an agent-owned os.pipe(), so process.wait() returns on run.sh exit even when a leftover helper holds the pipe; the drain is bounded by term_grace_s, then the runner session is SIGKILLed. Regression test_leftover_process_holding_the_output_pipe_cannot_hold_the_slot fails on the previous head and passes now.

Greptile P1 (log reads can freeze cleanup) fixed: diag_tail opens with O_NONBLOCK and refuses non-regular files after fstat; _log_diag is bounded by term_grace_s. Regression test_diag_tail_never_blocks_on_a_fifo_swapped_in_after_the_listing fails on the previous head and passes now.

Docs, README, repo-setup guide, actionlint config and ci_runner_scope no longer carve out a vps-docker runner: Docker-needing jobs migrate onto omega-ci using binaries baked into the runner image (task 00056).
unverified: No docker build of the Desktop image (no docker on the box): the new Dockerfile build-check RUN (setpriv as UID 1500 in /var/lib/omega-ci/work) is verified only by simulation as the non-root box user, not in the real image. setpriv presence in the accetto base is assumed (util-linux).
The real-runner pytest runs as the non-root box user owning the tree, not as a distinct job UID (needs root).
No live Railway/VPS/GitHub run; the smoke workflow must be re-dispatched after the Desktop rebuilds from main.
Full omega_prime/tests suite not run locally; CI covers it.
Pool-level circuit only: there is no separate per-job breaker; the pool circuit stops all launches after 5 consecutive pre-job exits.
contract_changes: error event exited_before_job gains exit_code; launch_circuit_open gains queued and action; agent log now contains redacted runner output lines.
rollback_plan: Revert the PR. Reverting restores 0711 (runners cannot start) and the exit-0 hot loop, so keep the controller stopped if reverted.
